artworks.title: The Old Clothes Dealer, Cairo
artworks.artist: Stephen James Ferris, after Jean-Léon Gérôme
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The man is standing in a slightly angled position, facing left. He has a serious expression, a beard, and is wearing a turban. His clothing is traditional, with draped garments and loose sleeves. He holds objects in his hands. There are dogs around him. In the background, another person is visible in traditional attire, with a head covering. The setting is a street with tall buildings, casting shadows. The architecture has intricate detailing, giving richness to the scene.

artworks.title: Le recors
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature-style drawing with two men inside a horse-drawn carriage and another man standing on a step at the back. The man outside wears a long coat and a top hat. The two men inside wear top hats and formal clothing, with one showing visible facial features. The carriage displays the number "13." The background is a sketch of a cityscape with minimal details. The drawing is monochromatic with shading and line work.

artworks.title: Garden, Mission Santa Barbara
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a courtyard surrounded by mission-style architecture. The horizon is made up of roofs and bell towers. The brushstrokes are detailed, highlighting the texture of the buildings and plants. The etching is monochromatic with sepia tones. In the foreground, there is a path with plants leading to two figures and a well. In the background, there are archways and a tall tree near the main building structure.

artworks.title: Kensington Gardens, No. 1
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on Japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a view through a grove of tall, mature trees with thick trunks and branches extending upward to create a canopy of leaves. The trees frame a large, classical-style building in the distance. The building features tall windows and a symmetrical form, situated along the obscured horizon line. The artwork uses an etching technique with fine lines to render textures and shadows, creating depth in the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of black and gray to emphasize the contrast between the dark trees and the lighter building in the background.

artworks.title: Coal Pockets at New Bedford
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image features a riverside scene depicted from a ground-level point of view. The horizon is low, showing distant buildings to the left. The style is etching with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and shading. At the front, there is a sandy shore with logs and a block leading to a docked boat beside a wooden structure. This structure has vertical elements and is central. In the water, a rowing boat with a figure is visible. The color palette is black and gray, creating a somber atmosphere. The background shows a cloudy sky and birds etched with delicate lines.

artworks.title: Gallery, Aston Hall, Warwickshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a hallway in an opulent building. The hallway is grand and ornately decorated with a luxurious red carpet, intricately carved wooden paneling, and an elaborately decorated ceiling featuring ornate plasterwork. Chairs, paintings in gilded frames, windows, objects on the carpet, a fireplace, and decorative vases also adorn the hallway.

artworks.title: The Drawing Room, Aston Hall, Warwickshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornately decorated room. The room features a richly designed interior with a detailed coffered ceiling adorned with intricate patterns and carvings. The walls are filled with decorative woodwork, and large windows allow natural light to flood the space. To one side, there is an elaborate fireplace, above which hangs a framed artwork. The floors are covered with a luxurious red carpet, and the room is furnished with dark wood and red upholstery chairs. A large table draped with a red cloth is centrally placed under the windows.

artworks.title: The Pond at Cernay-la-Ville
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The scene includes detailed natural elements such as grass, trees, hills, clouds, and water. The artwork shows a monochromatic color palette dominated by sepia tones, creating a vintage look.

artworks.title: Soldiers in a Devastated Landscape [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing split into two parts. The upper portion includes sparse, barren trees drawn with angular strokes, arranged on a slight rise suggesting a rural landscape. The lower part depicts figures riding in a horse-drawn wagon towards a village in the distance. The figures and wagon are outlined roughly, with sparse details. In the background, there are indistinct buildings and structures, creating a monochromatic composition using varying intensities of gray pencil.

artworks.title: Ophelia
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a person from the waist up. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side, with their gaze directed outward to the viewer's left. They have distinct facial features with a prominent nose and expressive eyes. Their long hair cascades in waves around their shoulders, adorned with a delicate garland or floral decoration. The person is clothed in what appears to be a simple garment, but specific details are obscured by the monochromatic style of the image. They are holding a bouquet of flowers close to the chest, with the hand partly visible. The background is dark and textured, bringing focus to the individual's face and the flowers.

artworks.title: To the Washington Light Infantry of Washington City
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a military uniform, standing upright. He wears a dark blue coat with gold epaulets, light blue trousers, a red sash, and a black shako with a feather plume. He holds a sword against his left shoulder, wearing white gloves. In the background is a grand building resembling the U.S. Capitol, with an American flag, against a light blue sky. The ground is grassy with patches visible. Text at the top and bottom includes "U.S. Military Magazine" and dedication to the "Washington Light Infantry of Washington City."

artworks.title: Morning Mist
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two sailing ships from a side perspective against a misty background. The larger ship is on the right, detailed with rigging and sails, while the smaller ship is on the left, fading into the mist. The horizon is indistinct, blending with the sky. The etching technique features fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and shadow. The color palette is subdued, using shades of gray and sepia.

artworks.title: Chicken Vendor, Trinidad
artworks.medium: drypoint with sandpaper in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in the foreground. One person stands upright, holding a stick or cane, wearing a long garment with a hood. The other person is seated on the ground, wrapped in a patterned shawl or blanket, gesturing with one arm raised. Various items are scattered on the ground around them, including bowls and possibly small animals or birds. In the background are indistinct figures, muted in color, possibly in a crowd, with some structures and a large palm tree on the left. The setting appears to be a marketplace or community space.

artworks.title: Old Dominy House
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1935)
artworks.description: The image displays a shingle-style house, depicted from a slightly elevated view, emphasizing the roof and side of the building. The horizon is low, almost hidden by the house and surrounding trees. The artwork uses detailed etching to create texture in the shingles and tree leaves. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or muted ink. Large trees frame the house, while light and shadows suggest early morning or late afternoon.

artworks.title: The English Elms
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image features a tree with a large trunk and long branches, surrounded by lush foliage and other trees in a park setting. The artwork uses intricate linework with hatching to depict the textures of the tree and leaves. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. In the background, people are seen walking and interacting. The contrast between dark lines and light areas creates the impression of a sunny day with shadows on the ground.

artworks.title: Encore mes créanciers, toujours ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two men facing each other. The man on the left is standing with his body angled towards the other man, holding papers. He has a long nose, short hair, and is wearing a top hat, a long coat, and pants. The man on the right looks startled, with wide eyes and an open mouth. He has tousled hair and is wearing a coat, a waistcoat, trousers, and a cravat. Papers are scattered around them, adding movement to the scene. The background is a simple indoor setting with faint lines indicating a wall.

artworks.title: Fifth Avenue, Noon
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing an aerial view of a busy city street. A grand building is on the left, with people, carriages, and vendors on the street below. Tall and detailed buildings line the street, creating a vertical presence in the distance. The etching style features precise linear strokes in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Inner Harbor, Gloucester
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with buildings and trees in the background, viewed across a body of water. The buildings have steep gable roofs and are clustered together. Tall ships with masts are visible above the structures, and the horizon is obscured. The artwork features detailed, intricate brushstrokes resembling an etching or drawing style. The color palette is monochrome, with shades of beige and darker lines for depth. Small boats and a rower are depicted on the water, along with larger vessels at the water's edge. Reflections and ripples in the water are suggested with horizontal lines at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Hight Tide, Montauk
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures interacting with a beach environment. The figures are depicted in various poses; one of them crouches and touches the water in the foreground, while the other two appear more relaxed in the background, among sandy and rocky textures. The lines and cross-hatching technique illustrate the sand's textured surface and suggest the movement of water. The setting captures a tranquil moment by the shore, utilizing shading to convey depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Girl in a Modern Gown
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a woman standing straight in a doorway. She has tied her hair back in a bun and wears a dark, short-sleeved blouse and a long, patterned skirt. Her hands are positioned in front of her, resting against each other. In the background, there is a room visible through the doorway, containing a window with a view outside, and a simple wooden chair. The wall beside her features faint sketches or decorations.

artworks.title: Hickories in a Hayfield
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with fields and trees. There are tall trees on the left and right sides of the composition. In the background, there are more trees and low hills along the horizon. The color palette is black and white. The ground transitions from the trees to open fields with grass.

artworks.title: Excellent placement
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing in profile facing each other. The man on the left has curly hair and prominent facial features, wearing a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt and light trousers. The man on the right is holding a top hat, wearing a long dark coat with matching trousers and shoes. The background includes simple line drawings of an interior setting with an arched doorway or window and possibly a curtain or drapery.

artworks.title: The Old House, Cos Cob
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic two-story building with a large tree on the right side, its branches extending across the scene. The viewpoint is slightly below the house's first floor, offering an upwards view to the upper porch with a railing. The house sits on a stone foundation with a wraparound porch. The horizon is concealed by the house and surrounding vegetation. The style seems to be an etching or detailed line drawing characterized by intricate lines indicating texture and shadow. The scene is monochromatic with light and dark variations created by line density. The garden or woodland surrounding the building is dense with foliage, adding depth. Stairs lead up to the entryway near us, and distant chimneys and wooden paneling contribute to the aged feel of the setting.

artworks.title: Old Chinatown, San Francisco
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior courtyard with a staircase. The scene shows a narrow alley or courtyard with a central, wooden staircase leading upwards to a platform. The structure around the staircase is made of wooden beams and boards, and there are various objects scattered around the bottom of the staircase. A small figure stands at the top, highlighted by the lighter area around it. Natural light streams in from above, illuminating the textures and creating a serene atmosphere.
